name: brigata-studio2go
description: A private, self-hosted Brigata AI agent + Studio that runs entirely on your Unraid box. No cloud dependency and no inbound connection required — you reach it on your LAN. The only outbound traffic is to the Anthropic API for the model (your key). Password login; embedded Postgres persisted to appdata.

paths.name: Data (Postgres + config)
paths.description: Persistent data — the embedded database and generated config. Survives updates.

paths.name: Homelab access (optional)
paths.description: OPTIONAL: mount your shares so the agent can read/manage files (e.g. Frigate config). Remove to keep it isolated.

paths.name: Docker control (optional, powerful)
paths.description: OPTIONAL + ROOT-EQUIVALENT: lets the agent create/manage containers (e.g. set up an NVR). Only enable if you want that.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the Studio web UI + API listen on

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The login password for the admin user (set on first boot)

variables.name: Anthropic API key
variables.description: sk-ant-api03-... or sk-ant-oat01-... — used only when the agent runs
